about_the_game:
This DLC contains hundreds of unpublished high-definition stills of actors;

The actors and characters are closely interdependent and highly independent of each other, but in the intervals between shooting, the actors and characters reach a certain tacit understanding. The virtual characters and real actors, originally independent of each other, seem to overlap at this moment, and some beauty and agility are born in such a moment;
We firmly believe that beauty is subjective, so in this DLC, we put as many photos as possible for everyone to choose;
This DLC is the second updated DLC, and there will be a video collection DLC to be updated later;
You can download and view the pictures in this DLC, but you cannot use them for any commercial purpose;
